source_title: MEK inhibitors for neurofibromatosis type 1 manifestations: Clinical evidence and consensus
claim_text: In a phase 1 trial of selumetinib in 24 children with inoperable NF1-related plexiform neurofibromas, 17 (71%) achieved a confirmed partial response (>20% volume decrease on MRI), with no complete responses.
notes: Full text (PMC9629420, HTML). Statement made by the de Blank 2022 review citing Dombi 2016 (PMID 28029918, ref 20). Secondary citation: the claim is not independent of the cited primary study; read the primary paper for strength grading.
